expectations.text: Recommends a 12-month cap as the default duration rule

expectations.text: Offers a renewal bonus of roughly 5-10% of renewal value as the way to compete on perceived generosity without open-ended liability
expectations.evidence: 'add a renewal bonus: 5-10% of month-13+ renewal revenue, paid in arrears on confirmed billing. It keeps top affiliates earning past month 12 ... without an unbounded per-customer tail.'

expectations.text: Explains the liability: on a sticky product, a long-tenured customer can earn an affiliate more than that customer's margin
expectations.evidence: The transcript discusses tail exposure ('about 1 in 108 acquired customers is still active ... five years after signup') and standing liability, but never states that a long-tenured customer's cumulative commission can exceed that customer's margin/profit contribution to the company.
